one_liner: Payments and financial infrastructure platform with APIs for payments, payouts, subscriptions/invoicing, identity, and Connect.
access_notes: Anyone can sign up, get test keys/sandboxes, and go live after self-serve account activation/KYC.

evidence.quote: This reference lists available public methods for our OAuth endpoints for Connect.
The Stripe API uses API keys to authenticate requests.
You can create an HTTPS webhook endpoint to receive events. After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it…
A sandbox is an isolated test environment… For new integrations, use general sandboxes…
This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe’s API.

_trail.quote: Access is self_serve_free with no material caveats, so buildability set to ready and blocker to none; MCP notes clarified as official Stripe server.
